import subprocess, time

# schtasks /Run /TN CITS_KabuStart_IT を実行してプロセスを監視
def kabu_running():
    r = subprocess.run('tasklist /fi "IMAGENAME eq KabuS.exe" /fo csv /nh', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    return 'KabuS' in r.stdout

print('Before:', 'RUNNING' if kabu_running() else 'NOT_RUNNING')

# Method 1: CITS_KabuStart_IT
r = subprocess.run('schtasks /Run /TN "CITS_KabuStart_IT"', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
print(f'CITS_KabuStart_IT result: rc={r.returncode} out={r.stdout[:100]} err={r.stderr[:100]}')

for i in range(6):
    time.sleep(10)
    running = kabu_running()
    print(f'  +{(i+1)*10}s: {"RUNNING" if running else "not_found"}')
    if running:
        break

if not kabu_running():
    # Method 2: Try CITS_KabuStation_Start task
    r = subprocess.run('schtasks /Run /TN "CITS_KabuStation_Start"', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    print(f'CITS_KabuStation_Start result: rc={r.returncode} out={r.stdout[:100]} err={r.stderr[:100]}')
    time.sleep(30)
    print('After CITS_KabuStation_Start:', 'RUNNING' if kabu_running() else 'NOT_FOUND')

if kabu_running():
    print('KabuS.exe CONFIRMED RUNNING!')
    time.sleep(10)
    r = subprocess.run('curl -s -X POST http://localhost:18080/kabusapi/token -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\\"APIPassword\\":\\"hiroki0380\\"}"', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    print('API result:', r.stdout[:300])
else:
    print('FAILED: KabuS.exe not found via any method')
    # Check Event Log for KabuS crash
    r = subprocess.run('wevtutil qe Application /q:"*[System[Provider[@Name=\'KabuS\']]]" /c:3 /rd:true /f:text 2>&1', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    print('EventLog:', r.stdout[:200])
